app.title: hyper-grid
app.privateKeyHelp: Private key is stored locally only. To replace it, clear the field and paste a new key.
app.marketsRateLimited: Exchange rate limit (429). Wait ~30s then refresh; any loaded list stays usable.
app.leverageHelp: This market allows {{min}}x–{{max}}x (exchange limit). Higher leverage means higher liquidation risk.
app.breakoutPause: Pause replenishment; keep orders and position
app.cancelOrdersKeepPosition: Cancel orders and stop; keep position
app.previewMaxLoss: Max loss in range ≈ {{loss}} USDC · Est. margin ≈ {{margin}} USDC.
app.previewMaxLossLiq: Max loss in range ≈ {{loss}} USDC (liq wipes margin) · Est. margin ≈ {{margin}} USDC.
app.alreadyRunningTip: Bot is already running. Stop it first if you want to restart.
app.stopFlattenHint: Stop cancels this strategy symbol's orders and closes its position with IOC. Other symbols are untouched.
app.stopConfirm: This cancels strategy orders and closes this symbol's position. Closing the window does not flatten.
app.dynamicGridHelp: ATR computes the band; after confirmed breakout the grid recenters with position kept.
app.dynamicBoundsHint: Bounds are ATR estimates; preview and start use this band.
app.dynamicFitRangeHint: In dynamic mode the band comes from ATR — refresh to update.
app.autoStartHelp: On open, if there is no resumable session, start the grid with the saved config.
app.haltBanner: Hard risk or reconcile failure — will not auto-restart.
app.offlineRiskBanner: While the app is closed, exchange orders can still fill, but local replenish, dynamic recenter, and software risk controls are offline. Exchange liquidation risk remains.
app.statusNoteBreakoutPause: Breakout pause: replenishment stopped; orders and position kept
app.statusNoteBreakoutKeepPosition: Breakout stop: orders canceled; position kept
app.statusNoteBreakoutClosed: Breakout stop: orders canceled and position closed
app.statusNoteRiskStop: Strategy equity risk limit reached; orders canceled and position closed
app.nextFundingHelp: Estimated next hourly funding cash flow from current position, mark and rate (positive = receive); countdown to the hour.
app.analyticsHint: Top cards are all-session totals. Equity curve: period total or a clicked session. Export for reconciliation.
app.analyticsClearSessionMsg: Deletes fills, funding, and equity snapshots for session {{id}}. Does not touch exchange orders/positions or stop a running bot.
app.analyticsClearAllMsg: Deletes all session fills, funding, equity snapshots, and inactive session rows. Keeps the active session metadata; exchange orders/positions are untouched.
app.analyticsUnrealizedHint: Mark-to-market position PnL; not settled cash
app.analyticsAllSessionsHint: Cards above sum every session; per-session detail is in the list and equity curve.
app.flattenHint: Please wait while the exchange operation completes.
app.depositHint: Fund on Hyperliquid first. New accounts default to Unified Account — USDC is shared collateral for perps, so Spot→Perp transfer is usually unnecessary. This app only trades with your private key.
app.balancesEmpty: No balances. After switching mode, click Refresh balances. Confirm testnet faucet and matching address.
app.lowerHelp: Lowest price of your grid ladder.
app.upperHelp: Highest price of your grid ladder.
app.gridHelp: How many rungs on the ladder.
app.budgetHelp: Total size of all grid orders (USDC). At least $10 per level. Rough margin needed ≈ total ÷ leverage ÷ 2.
app.drawdownHelp: Cancel, close and stop when strategy equity (budget + net realized PnL + unrealized PnL) draws down this % from its peak; 0 disables.
app.dailyLossHelp: Cancel, close and stop when strategy equity loses this quote amount from its local-day opening value; resets daily in the computer timezone, 0 disables.
app.orderFailHelp: Cancel, close and stop after this many consecutive order placement failures.
app.screenerHint: Ranks perps for range-grid suitability using liquidity, move, funding, and leverage limits.
app.screenerVolHint: Click “Candle vol analysis” for top-volume 1h candles (official: 1200 weight/min IP; candleSnapshot≈21 → ~2.1s each).
app.screenerVolStatus: Candle vol computed for {{count}} markets (K badge).
app.screenerVolRateLimited: Hit official IP rate limit (1200 weight/min) after {{done}}/{{total}}. Backed off and retried; try again later if still incomplete.
app.screenerApplied: Selected {{symbol}}. Continue with range and grid settings.
app.screenerAppliedWithRange: Selected {{symbol}} and filled ±{{pct}}% from realized vol.
app.screenerEmpty: No markets match these filters. Try relaxing them.
app.screenerWeights: Weights: volume 40% · moderate move 30% · funding 20% · leverage 10%. With candles, daily ATR replaces simple day change. Guidance only.

screenerReason.goodRange: Move in sweet spot for grids
